Welcome, Thinking Paleontologist
My name Date 
This is your Level 2 workbook (Development, ages 8–10). A paleontologist digs out
evidence, reads the layers, and argues for what it means. You will do the same with ten
texts this year.
Every text has four lessons. Every lesson has one page. The pages always go in the
same order, and they match the Level 2 Teacher Pack lesson by lesson:
Excavation Find exactly what the text says and what it suggests.
Strata Weigh two sides of a Big Question and take a position.
JustificationBuild the CEIW argument: Claim, Evidence, Interpretation, Warrant.
Impact Connect the text to the real world and the living world.
Your
rule
for
evidence. Every quote you write comes from your own copy of the book, is
short, and has a page number. Opinions without evidence are not enough. The warrant,
explaining why the evidence proves your claim, is the most important move.
Word
Fossils. Collect strong words as you read. Record them in the Fossil Log at the end of
the book.
